name: Jesus II
source:
Set 4 years after the events of the first game, the game begins onboard the Callisto, a passenger ship sailing across the Mediterranean Sea. An object from the sky suddenly crashes near where the Callisto is, and causes a big impact. Kazuya Goshiki – a 3WD mechanic travelling onboard - gets knocked out by the blast whilst on the deck. When he wakes up he finds out that the object was some sort of container, and had been salvaged by the ship.

[from [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在前作四年后，开场位于航行于地中海的客轮“卡利斯托”号上。一个物体突然从天而降，坠落在卡利斯托号附近，引发巨大冲击。正在船上旅行的三轮驱动机械师五色和也当时身处甲板，被爆炸震晕。醒来后，他得知坠落物似乎是某种容器，已经被客轮打捞上来。

[摘自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
